title: Change ship-status exits 1 when it reports a blocker
description: change ship-status exits 1 when it reports a blocker
acceptance_criteria: an approved, unverified change: change ship-status <id> prints its Blocker line and exits 1, and --json prints one document with a non-empty blockers list and exits 1; change ship-status with no id exits 1 when any listed change has a blocker; a change ready to finalize and a closed-late change exit 0 as before

answers.constraints: the report text and JSON are unchanged; JSON stays one document; a timed-out read still exits 124 and an unreadable roster still exits 1
